draft_baseline.method: Original published draft projection, preserved from Git. Changes since draft can include subsequent model changes as well as results and ratings.

race_story.note: Pick changes are changes in expected final points, not an additive explanation of championship probability. Results, ratings, and model updates can all contribute.

routes.condition: Wisconsin loses at least 3 of its next 4 games
routes.headline: Root against Wisconsin.
routes.story: Blaine gets a better shot if Wisconsin loses at least 3 of its next 4 games.
routes.why: Blaine picked Wisconsin to fall short of its preseason win target. Losses are good news for that pick.
routes.difficulty: Needs a few things to break right
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 11 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.narrative: The awkward part: Blaine benefits when Wisconsin has a bad Saturday. A close escape still counts as a win, so ugly football alone will not do the job.
routes.banter: Blaine runs bakeries. This Wisconsin pick still has to prove it is more than hot air. Please allow the group one baking joke before kickoff.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Blaine has a stronger title case and a ready-made reason to remind everyone about this pick.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
